cards.questionText:
Tips for designing a website for a food-truck business

Food trucks typically operate by traveling between different locations within or across cities, which means they often depend on word-of-mouth recommendations or social media platforms to attract customers. For this reason, many food truck owners may not prioritize creating their own website. However, given the nature of the business, it is actually very important to have a dedicated online space where customers can easily find information, place orders, or get in touch. In addition, market studies indicate that having a website can significantly help in building a loyal customer base. With that in mind, the following are some useful suggestions for creating an effective website for a food truck business.

The Home page should feature eye-catching visuals along with the food truck’s name displayed prominently. Essential details such as operating hours and current locations should be clearly highlighted in the main text. It is best to avoid placing too much information upfront, so features like online forms (for example, reservation requests for private events or services) should be provided through links or pop-up windows rather than shown directly on the page.

The Food Menu page should present high-quality, appealing images accompanied by clear and descriptive text that explains each dish in detail. It is also important to ensure that images are large enough to remain visually attractive when viewed on bigger screens such as desktop monitors.

The About Us page should describe the food truck’s concept and overall theme, along with background information about the owners or team, particularly their experience in the food industry.

The News page may be used to update visitors about seasonal menu items, upcoming promotions, or special events like food festivals.

To: Doug Abruzzo dabruzzo@dzacreative.com

From: Ed Vale evale@saffronmail.com

Date: March 29

Subject: Feedback

Dear Mr. Abruzzo,

Thank you once again for developing the prototype website for my food truck business. I would like to emphasize that it has received favorable responses from the customers who have tested it. I am very pleased that we took into account the recommendations from the article you shared regarding website design for food trucks.

Following up on our phone conversation yesterday, we will proceed with the prototype and officially launch the website on April 5. However, I have noticed that the details I previously provided about our upcoming mid-April promotion - offering a free dessert with every sandwich purchase - have not yet been included. Please ensure this key information is added before the site goes live.

Kind regards,

Ed

childQuestions.questionText: According to the article, which of the following methods has traditionally been used by food truck owners to attract customers?
options: By displaying signs at food festivals
childQuestions.transcript: The article states that food trucks "often rely on word-of-mouth recommendations or social media platforms to attract customers."
childQuestions.explanationVi: Bài viết cho biết rằng các xe bán đồ ăn "often rely on word-of-mouth recommendations or social media platforms to attract customers."

childQuestions.questionText: According to the article, which of the following details is not required to be displayed on the Home page?
childQuestions.transcript: The Home page should include the business name, operating hours, and locations. Seasonal food items belong on the News page.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trang Home cần bao gồm tên doanh nghiệp, giờ hoạt động và các địa điểm. Các món ăn theo mùa thuộc về trang News.

childQuestions.questionText: What profession is Mr. Abruzzo most likely involved in?
childQuestions.transcript: Ed thanks Mr. Abruzzo for "developing the prototype website" and discusses website content with him.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Ed cảm ơn ông Abruzzo vì đã "developing the prototype website" và thảo luận về nội dung trang web với ông.

childQuestions.questionText: In which part of the website will the information most likely be added?
childQuestions.transcript: The missing information concerns an upcoming promotion ("free dessert with every sandwich purchase"), and the article says promotions should be posted on the News page.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin bị thiếu liên quan đến một chương trình khuyến mãi sắp tới ("free dessert with every sandwich purchase"), và bài viết cho biết các chương trình khuyến mãi nên được đăng trên trang News.

childQuestions.questionText: According to the e-mail, when will the Web site launch?
childQuestions.transcript: Ed writes, "we will proceed with the prototype and officially launch the website on April 5."
childQuestions.explanationVi: Ed viết rằng: "we will proceed with the prototype and officially launch the website on April 5."

cards.questionText:
To: Manny Green mgreen@rhba.com

From: John LaRose jlarose@rilamore.edu

Date: May 18

Subject: Drilling Notice

Dear Mr. Green,

I am contacting you on behalf of Rilamore University and would appreciate your assistance in informing members of the Red Hills Business Association. As reported in last month’s Daily Gazette, the university is proceeding with its Net Zero Initiative. Our goal is to have a fully operational geothermal heating and cooling system serving the entire campus within the next three years. Reducing dependence on fossil fuels has been a long-standing objective of the university, and this project represents a major milestone toward that objective.

During the coming month, we will conduct test drilling in several campus locations. Provided everything remains on schedule, drilling operations near the Red Hills Business District and Oak Street Apartments are expected to begin on Wednesday, June 5. We would like nearby business owners and residents to be aware that noise levels may be higher than normal during the approximately two-week period required to complete the work. The drilling team will operate from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.

We sincerely regret any disruption this project may cause to those living and working nearby. Anyone with questions or concerns is encouraged to contact me directly at 813-555-0123.

Sincerely,

John LaRose

Community Liaison, Rilamore University Office of Communications

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Contact: Manny Green, mgreen@rhba.com

RED HILLS (May 25) - The Red Hills Business Association has announced a change to the schedule of its popular Lunch Hour Concert Series. Rather than being held on Thursdays throughout June, the four complimentary concerts will now be presented on Thursdays in July. The performance lineup remains the same: the series will begin with the Jaystone Jazz Trio on July 4, followed by Joss and the Jaybirds, Ray Starform, and finally the Barklay Bass Quintet on the following Thursdays.

As in previous years, all three blocks of Oak Street will be closed to vehicle traffic. Local restaurants will offer outdoor lunch service, and arts-and-crafts vendors from the community will showcase their products on the Cultural Center lawn. This event continues to be a wonderful community celebration in one of Red Hills’ most vibrant neighborhoods, and we look forward to welcoming everyone there.

childQuestions.questionText: What is indicated about the Net Zero Initiative?
options: The project is receiving financial support from the Red Hills Business Association.
The idea was modeled after comparable programs in other cities.
Geothermal energy will be used to supply power to an entire city.
The initiative will alter the method an institution uses to heat its buildings.
correctOptions: The initiative will alter the method an institution uses to heat its buildings.
childQuestions.transcript: The email states that the university plans to install a geothermal heating and cooling system for the entire campus, changing how campus buildings are heated and cooled.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Email cho biết rằng trường đại học dự định lắp đặt hệ thống sưởi ấm và làm mát địa nhiệt cho toàn bộ khuôn viên, qua đó thay đổi cách các tòa nhà trong khuôn viên được sưởi ấm và làm mát.

childQuestions.questionText: In paragraph 2, line 1 of the e-mail, the word "conduct" is closest in meaning to:
childQuestions.transcript: "Conduct test drilling" means perform or carry out test drilling activities.
childQuestions.explanationVi: “Conduct test drilling” có nghĩa là thực hiện hoặc tiến hành các hoạt động khoan thử nghiệm.

childQuestions.questionText: What can be concluded about the Red Hills Business District?
options: It is situated close to a university campus.
It serves as the venue for an annual arts festival in July.
The Oak Street Apartments are part of the district.
The headquarters of the Daily Gazette are located there.
correctOptions: It is situated close to a university campus.
childQuestions.transcript: The email says that drilling operations near the Red Hills Business District will occur in campus locations, indicating that the district is close to the university.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Email cho biết rằng các hoạt động khoan gần Khu thương mại Red Hills sẽ diễn ra tại các khu vực trong khuôn viên trường, điều này cho thấy khu vực này nằm gần trường đại học.

childQuestions.questionText: What is the most likely reason the Red Hills Business Association rescheduled its concert series?
options: To benefit from the availability of a new energy source
To align with students’ academic schedules
To avoid noise from nearby construction
To avoid overlapping with another similar event
correctOptions: To avoid noise from nearby construction
childQuestions.transcript: The concerts were originally planned for June, but university drilling near Oak Street is scheduled from June 5 for about two weeks and will generate significant noise. Moving the concerts to July avoids this disruption.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Các buổi hòa nhạc ban đầu được lên kế hoạch vào tháng 6, nhưng việc khoan của trường đại học gần Oak Street được dự kiến bắt đầu từ ngày 5 tháng 6 trong khoảng hai tuần và sẽ gây ra tiếng ồn đáng kể. Việc chuyển các buổi hòa nhạc sang tháng 7 giúp tránh sự gián đoạn này.

childQuestions.questionText: What detail about the Cultural Center is included in the press release?
options: It will have artwork for sale on its property.
It will host hands-on arts-and-crafts classes.
It will serve as the performance venue for artists.
It will supply meals for the musicians.
correctOptions: It will have artwork for sale on its property.
childQuestions.transcript: The press release states that "arts-and-crafts vendors from the community will showcase their products on the Cultural Center lawn," meaning items will be displayed and likely sold there.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông cáo báo chí cho biết rằng "arts-and-crafts vendors from the community will showcase their products on the Cultural Center lawn", nghĩa là các sản phẩm sẽ được trưng bày và có khả năng được bán tại đó.
